list.title: SMS campaigns
list.subtitle: Who is targeted, when we write, and what stops the ladder.

empty.title: No campaigns
empty.desc: Create a campaign to start writing to your leads.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteConfirm.body: This campaign never enrolled anyone: it will be permanently deleted.
deleteConfirm.bodyArchive: This campaign already enrolled people. It will be archived — enrollments and sent messages must stay readable.

create.title: Create a campaign
create.subtitle: Three ways to get there — each produces a complete campaign, as a draft.

ai.name: Describe your campaign
ai.pitch: Write down who you want to reach. We ask two or three questions, then set everything up.
ai.title: Describe your campaign
ai.subtitle: A few questions, and the campaign is ready to review.
ai.prompt: Who do you want to reach, and on what occasion?
ai.example: For example: “wake up buyers I haven't heard from in six months, with two follow-ups”
ai.noProvider: No model key configured — assisted creation needs a provider.
ai.retry: Unreadable model reply. Rephrase and try again.

simple.name: Simple setup
simple.pitch: Three choices: what triggers it, who it targets, and how many follow-ups.
simple.title: Simple setup
simple.subtitle: The three settings that decide who gets what, and when.

triggerHint.lead_created: Every new lead is enrolled as it arrives.
triggerHint.category_changed: When a contact moves to another pipeline stage.
triggerHint.scheduled: A regular sweep of your database, using a filter.
triggerHint.manual: You enroll people yourself, one at a time.

simple.oneHint: One reminder three days later. The usual setting.
simple.twoHint: Two spaced reminders. Watch the opt-out rate.

complex.name: Full setup
complex.pitch: Every setting: trigger, audience, ladder, A/B variants, caps, consent.
complex.title: Full setup
complex.subtitle: We create a draft, then you configure everything in the editor.
complex.note: The campaign is created as a draft, with cautious defaults. Nothing goes out until you activate it.

summary.dailyCap: {count, plural, one {# person / day} other {# people / day}}

basics.name: Name
basics.assistantHint: The assistant that carries the conversation once the opener is out.
basics.dailyCapHint: Bounds the ENTRY rate. The number's daily cap bounds sends.

trigger.manualHint: You pick the audience and enroll yourself.
trigger.leadHint: A lead arriving through the webhook is enrolled automatically.
trigger.categoryHint: The client enters one of the chosen categories.
trigger.scheduledHint: The audience is swept at a regular interval.

audience.title: Who is targeted
audience.notContactedHint: “Never contacted” counts too — otherwise reactivation misses the coldest leads.
audience.excludeActive: Exclude people already in another active campaign
audience.excludeActiveHint: Two campaigns in one week is what gets a number flagged.

ladder.title: Follow-up ladder
ladder.hint: Delays are CUMULATIVE: rung 2 fires after rung 1, not after enrollment.
ladder.bodyPlaceholder: The text sent. Empty = the assistant writes.
ladder.label: Internal label
ladder.empty: No rungs — the campaign would enroll people and never write to them.

variants.title: A/B test
variants.hint: Only the OPENER varies. Varying the whole ladder would make the result unattributable.
variants.none: No variants — everyone gets the same opener.

errors.assistantInactive: A rung lets the assistant write: pick an active assistant.
errors.noSender: No active sending number — the campaign would have nothing to write from.

import.title: Import a campaign
import.bindingsNote: The file comes from another installation: its ids point at nothing here. Anything with the same name, e-mail or number is linked automatically; pick the rest.
import.invalid: This file is not a valid campaign export.
import.draftNote: The campaign is imported as a draft: nothing goes out until you activate it here.

warning.unresolved_binding_cleared: "{target}" ({kind}) does not exist here: the field stays empty.
warning.unresolved_binding_removed: "{target}" ({kind}) does not exist here: removed from the list.
warning.docs_ignored: The file's "_docs" annotations are ignored: the documentation comes from this installation, not from the imported file.
